frames.title: 冰谷：实际影像与山体层次
冰谷：实际影像与山体层次

method: Unmodified actual movie frames, selected one second into the same authored response. Each version has its own measured time. No generated previews, texture enhancement or identical-pixel claim.
limits: Original stylized teaching actors; no motion capture or ethnographic reconstruction.
Same 10m imagery and retained elevation data; lighting and view changes do not raise measurement precision.
review: Inspected all six paired actual response frames: the R29 speaking caption remains below the hands and face; persistent side questions, locators and response labels no longer compete with it.
Inspected the two arrivals at three independently recorded phases: R29 holds the regional terrain during local emergence; the market remains surrounded by geographic context after arrival.
Arrival still deliberately enlarges regional/local geometry for teaching. Characters remain procedural miniature figures. Stills do not certify continuous movement or subjective listening.
